ogx.normal_process: Search existing issues; file a reproducible bug report or discussion when requirements are unclear. lscore.normal_process: New features need a request for enhancement in LCORE Jira for Red Hat contributors, or GitHub for external contributors, and roadmap vetting. Ordinary bug fixes do not need a separate RFE unless they change public behavior or expand into feature work. Use focused PRs, tests/docs, required format/verify/unit checks, a valid Jira title prefix, and disclosure of substantial AI assistance.
lscore.assessment: Wiring a new per-tool timeout capability needs semantics and owner agreement; it is larger than claiming the current reserved field already works. Dependency upgrades/backports should be proposed separately from ATI business behavior.
